notes.title: Pacifist Achievement Unlock Fix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the unlocking of the Pacifist Achievement.
[*] Previously, the achievement only worked if the player attempted it after starting the game. If the player killed an enemy and then tried again without restarting the game, the achievement would not unlock.
[*] Now, players can successfully achieve the Pacifist Achievement by reaching the end of level 3 without killing any enemies, regardless of when they attempt it.
[*] Thank you for your patience, and enjoy the improved achievement experience!
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix: Mini Boss Behavior
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In this update, we've addressed a bug that caused the mini boss to persist even after the level had ended.
[*] Now, when the timer reaches zero, the mini boss will vanish, indicating that players have successfully survived the phase.
[*] This fix ensures a more balanced and fair gameplay experience for all players.
[*] Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the improved gameplay in our latest update!
[/list]

notes.title: Let's chat about Hertz
notes.notes: Join us for an engaging Q&A session as we delve into the captivating gameplay, unique features, and the journey behind the development of Hertz. Get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the creation of the game and have your questions answered by the developers themselves. Don't miss out on this opportunity to chat about Hertz and discover what makes it a thrilling gaming experience.
